scope: Hash-bound static source findings for visual localization, Spanish host audio, glossary intent, Replay intent, and terminal intent. This is not runtime or acceptance evidence.

scripts.role: request parent InternalPreloader jump_check and stop root

excerpts.proves: The same-lesson shell exposes Spanish-audio controls for eligible lesson sections/pages.
The shell pauses course state and forwards KeyAttribute plus ~English to its glossary controller.
The shell derives SA/<child-basename>.mp3, stops animation_mc.animation, starts gSound, and conditionally resumes on completion.
The shell stops gSound and conditionally resumes the child when Spanish audio is manually stopped.
The full shell monitors the nested timeline and contains a stop branch at or beyond its terminal frame.
The Spanish-audio play control calls doPlaySpanishAudio.
The Spanish-audio stop control calls doStopSpanishAudio.
Replay resets host flags and Spanish-audio UI state, stops gSound, and calls loadSWFMovie.

childVisualLocalization.finding: The child has one deterministic visual timeline and no child ActionScript language branch. The same-lesson Spanish-audio host functions pause/resume that same child and do not switch its visual content.
childVisualLocalization.qualification: This is a static source-contract finding, not an authorized runtime observation and not permission to label the English artwork as translated Spanish content.

externalSpanishAudio.finding: The active child basename, the sibling SA/L3IN09.mp3, the host basename-routing function, and the byte-identical public copy agree.
externalSpanishAudio.implementationDisposition: Do not expose the track through generic timeline audio controls until stop/resume, completion, manual stop, Replay, listening, and synchronization are implemented and validated.

glossary.finding: Child release handlers, host DoHyperLinks, owner glossary XML, and owner glossary SWFs establish the requested term identities and legacy destinations.
glossary.implementationDisposition: Keep the scenarios fail-closed until exact hit geometry and a reviewed modern glossary route are available; both destination migrations remain discovered rather than complete.

replay.finding: The same-lesson host Replay handler resets playback, quiz, overlay, sound, and Spanish-audio state before reloading the current SWF.
replay.implementationDisposition: The current generic Replay button is only a candidate playhead reset and must not be described as source-equivalent.

terminal.finding: The full lesson shell enter-frame monitor can stop the child at its total-frame boundary.
terminal.implementationDisposition: Do not replace the candidate loop with once/stopped behavior until authorized execution establishes event ordering and terminal state.

resolvedAtStaticSourceContractLevel: The child does not contain a script-controlled Spanish visual branch.
The exact owner Spanish MP3 and legacy host basename route are identified.
The Temperature and Measure glossary request keys and owner destinations are identified.
The source Replay reload intent and terminal stop intent are identified.
remainingBlockers: Authorized original same-lesson host execution must reach this child and establish natural entry and event ordering.
A qualified listener must verify the Spanish MP3 spoken language/content and the embedded stream language/content.
Spanish audio start, child pause, completion/manual-stop resume, terminal behavior, and Replay reset require runtime validation.
Every reachable trace and frame in both root and sprite-200 domains still lacks an authoritative complete baseline and full-frame RMSE evidence.
Glossary button hit geometry and reviewed modern destinations are not implemented or validated.
Keyboard, reduced-motion, mobile, console, network, human diff review, and owner acceptance remain outside this static artifact.

limitations: Static ActionScript proves coded intent, not that the original runtime executed the branch in the expected order.
Directory naming and host routing prove intended Spanish association, not spoken content; no listening is recorded here.
No audio is rendered by the current JavaScript candidate, and this artifact does not add an audio cue.
The current generated Canvas asset still fails closed for lang=es; updating that reviewed generator contract is a separate implementation/review step.
No screenshot, pixel comparison, RMSE result, interaction trace, human decision, owner decision, or status change is created by this artifact.
